explainer_content.short_definition: 2000s indie rediscovering post-punk's angles, basslines, and dark dance-floor tension.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road follows bands that made older post-punk moves feel new inside the blog/indie era: sharp guitars, cool surfaces, and rhythm you can dance to.

explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The distinction is angularity and mood: darker, more bass-driven, and more mannered than simple garage rock revival.
